output_list.criticism: The 'mintToken' function does not check the overflow of 'target' thus an attacker can set the 'initialSupply' of any user to any value, aka 'Overflow Attack'.
The 'transfer' function does not prevent overflow of '_value' when _to is zero address, aka 'Overflow Input.'
The 'transferFrom' function does not prevent overflow of '_value' when _to is zero address, aka 'Overflow Input.'
The 'buy' function does not prevent overflow of 'msg.value * buyRate' when 'msg.value' and 'buyRate' are both large, aka 'Integer Overflow.'
